topic: K-beauty is topping bestseller lists before Black Friday (rides @CNBC K-beauty post, 22,449 views)
text:
Korean skincare is topping bestseller lists ahead of Black Friday.

Not surprised. After 40, the Korean idea that won me over was simple: layer thin, let each layer dry, repeat.

Booster. Serum. Booster. Cream.

Which K-beauty step would you try first?
picture_tip: Your Dermatology Booster EX, Serum EX and Dermatology Cream lined up in that order on a dry counter by a window, small handwritten card: 1-2-3-4. Square or 16:9.
video_tip: 10-12 s: spray Booster and pause (2 s), massage in Serum (3 s), second Booster spray (2 s), spatula of Cream, massage in (3 s). On-screen text: 'Let each layer dry'.

topic: Chapped lips myth-bust (rides winter chapped-lips chatter: @pfaffphobic 799, @sillyfrenchfryy 431)
text:
Chapped lips aren't a winter personality trait.

3 habits that helped mine after 40:
1. Stop licking them. It feels like it helps. It doesn't.
2. A generous layer of lip oil before bed
3. A balm stick in every coat pocket

Save this for the first frosty morning.
picture_tip: Close-up of your ICD Glow Up Lip Oil and Multi Stick Balm on your nightstand next to a book and a lamp. Simple, no text.
video_tip: 6-8 s: Multi Stick Balm out of a coat pocket and swiped on (3 s), cut to nightstand, generous layer of Glow Up Lip Oil, lamp clicks off (4 s). On-screen text: 'Winter lips, 3 habits'.
